result:
To help determine your personality type, I can calculate your Big Five personality traits. Please rate the following 10 statements on a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 is "Strongly Disagree" and 5 is "Strongly Agree":

1. I am the life of the party.
2. I sympathize with others' feelings.
3. I get chores done right away.
4. I have a rich vocabulary.
5. I am relaxed most of the time.
6. I am not interested in people.
7. I feel little concern for others.
8. I often leave my belongings around.
9. I have difficulty understanding verbal material.
10. I am easily disturbed by my personal problems.

message.content: What type of personality am I?

function.name: calculate_big_five_traits
function.description: Calculate the big five personality traits based on a set of questions answered by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

answers.description: Answers to a set of questions rated on a scale from 1 to 5.

calculate_percentile.description: If true, the percentile rank for each trait will also be calculated.

average_answers.description: If true, answers will be averaged across each trait's questions.
